items.title: I looked into buying a house in Singapore as an investment. Here’s why I didn’t — despite the 2% mortgage rate.
items.body: Home-loan interest rates in Singapore are less than 2%, while in Japan they’re around 1% or even lower. That’s in stark contrast to mortgage rates in America and Australia, which are over 6% on average.
